description: Use this when an agent needs legacy SEC fundamentals or filings (prefer get_stocks_data). Pass symbol (default AAPL). Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: filings (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), fundamentals (17 sats or $0.01 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).

name: get_stock_data
title: US stock and SEC data
